# Introduction {#sec-introduction}

## Scope of application {#sec-scope-of-application}

The system map covers IT systems of the federal government, the cantons and the private sector that process data of the agri-food sector, as well as the datasets these systems contain and the organizations that operate, own or develop them.
It serves as a shared reference to make data flows and responsibilities visible.

## Visualisation {#sec-visualisation}

The [system map frontend](https://github.com/damian-oswald/system-map-frontend) displays the graph directly in the browser; it queries the data live from LINDAS.

# Usage notes {#sec-usage-notes}

The data is maintained in Turtle [@Turtle], described by an OWL ontology [@OWL2] and validated with SHACL [@SHACL]; datasets follow the DCAT vocabulary [@DCAT].

# Data retrieval {#sec-data-retrieval}

The system map is published as _Linked Data_ on [LINDAS](https://lindas.admin.ch/), the linked data service of the federal administration, and can be queried with SPARQL [@SPARQL].
